rows.en:
[HERO2], don't say it!

I understand!

So… so please, don't say it!

[HERO4]…

I'm sorry, aren't I? Making you play such a painful part…

But the only one who can completely destroy this Fusion Steel is you, an organic droid programmed specially for it.

Yes…

Now, that is my mission… I will serve you to the very, very end.
Security Team has arrived!! We'll back you up right away.
Um… Mimi, I've got a favor to ask…
Could you lend me some money?
Huh? Money?
I want to have fun with the kids! Big time!
Sure… Take as much as you like! Even one of these jewels is worth tens of millions of yen.

That's rare…

Usually you don't even want to part with a thousand yen.
Oh… If you're going to say that, I won't give you any!
Hahaha… Joke, joke! Just a jokey-joke!! Thanks, Mimi!!
Gavan…
Be careful…
You're cute… especially today, Mimi!

"For Gavan… and for everyone on Earth, the time of battle is drawing near…

Dear God… please protect Gavan, and everyone."
Hmm… Open up a path for the assault team, whatever it takes! We have to draw the enemy's forces here…
By the way… the assault team is going to be all right, isn't it?
I've explained the whole operation to Mr. Tachibana. I'm sure they'll pull it off…
We have to acknowledge it, don't we? Their existence, and their tremendous power…

But, Captain…

that's an illusion we humans have built up in our own minds! And if so… there's no reason we can't destroy it.

…?

What's wrong, Go? Is something bothering you?

…………

Captain, let's stop using the radio! The enemy mothership is this close. They might be intercepting our radio too.

Captain… something's definitely off!

Some special radio wave is being discharged over this whole area, like a barrier.
Heh heh heh… As expected of Ultraman. It seems they've noticed what we're up to.

It was a fine diversion, but…

it seems we've spent a bit too much time on it. Begin preparations for the Naager's takeoff! Soon this Earth will be blown away without a trace…

Yes, just as if nothing had ever been there at all! Hah hah hah…
Atefarina… you've found my son, haven't you? Why does he not appear before me?

I-I'm terribly sorry…

Please wait just a little longer! I will surely bring him back, to the Steel Emperor's…

I have no time to listen to excuses!

Don't you understand!? The Earth will soon vanish! Bring him here at once! I cannot wait any longer!

…!

Y-yes, sir! At once, I'll bring [HERO2] to Your Majesty's side…

Some special radio wave is being discharged over that whole area.

In other words… everything we say over the radio is going straight to the enemy!
Exactly! We just need to put out jamming signals. And building that is my job…
An assault…!?
Let's do it! We'll protect our Earth with our own hands.
It's impossible…

…!?

Impossible?
Yeah, I hate to say it… but this time, there's nothing we can do.
What's this, [HERO2]? Don't tell me… you're getting cold feet?
It's nothing like that!
Then what is it?
There's a barrier around the space fortress… a powerful shield, so to speak!
No… even so, if we could just do something about the entrance…
That space fortress has no entrances or exits.
What!? No… entrances or exits?
The Dimensional Distortion Field serves as the way in and out. In other words, it's like an invisible door…
The only one who can lift the Dimensional Distortion Field is my sister Ryoko…
Your sister Ryoko…?
Atefarina the Battle Princess.

Sure… targeting the power reactor inside isn't a bad way to destroy that space fortress…

No, more than that, it may well be the only way to destroy it…

But… that ship isn't so flimsy that we can just slip inside.

I hate to say it…

but we've lost!
There's just one… one last way left.
For me to become the Black Knight Lucifard once more… and serve Steel Emperor Zephas.
But… can you really fool Atefarina like that?

Of course, there's no fooling her…

So I'll really go back! To being the evil Black Knight…
That's insane!? There's no guarantee you'll come back to your senses!
Yeah… Worse than that, I'll become everyone's enemy!
There's no other way to get the Dimensional Distortion Field lowered!
Gavan… I hear the Amigo Squad has been asked to sortie.
I see… So it's finally starting, the final battle…
You're going, aren't you?
Yeah, of course! Contact Sharivan and Shaider for me too.

I know…

Here! A charm…

I got it for you…
Thanks…
Be careful.
Yeah…
Take care…
"Come back! Please come back, Gavan…"
[HERO2]… are you really okay with this?

Yeah…

More importantly… if I switch sides, I'll be your toughest enemy, right? Better worry about that too.
That's not funny, even as a joke!
The Dimensional Distortion Field will only be lifted for the instant I board that ship! Don't miss your chance.

What!?

You knew…?

What!?

You knew…?

That's right!

And about your plan to send an assault team into our Space Fortress Naager and blow up the power reactor, too…

Still, what a lot of trouble you've gone to…

Surely you know it's impossible to get inside unless Atefarina opens the Dimensional Distortion Field?
Now, come with me! Kneel before Lord Steel Emperor Zephas.
All right, Sis…

"Sis"?

My, my? What's gotten into you? Being so meek all of a sudden!?

uncertain: U15621-U15623: route where [HERO4] is an organic droid serving [HERO2]; 官機ドロイド read as 有機ドロイド. The 'painful part' is destroying his Fusion Steel (i.e. him) at the end.
U15633: [ja] rendered 'Joke, joke! Just a jokey-joke!!'.
U15638: 袢様 read as 神様 ('Dear God').
U15652: お滕下 read as お膝下 ('to Your Majesty's side'); Atefarina calls Zephas 皇帝 here.
U15639-U15679: alternate-route copy of B0173 scenes; wording kept consistent.
U15668: リョウコ姉さん rendered 'my sister Ryoko'.
